description: Rear kitchen extension, attic conversion, excavation and extension of the front dry area, addition of two roof lights in the front roof and internal alterations.
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-2ec5af94-7fff-ef94-5434-3b58fa9f2449"></span></p><div><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space: pre-wrap; text-align: justify;">Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification, a drainage layout and a management &amp; maintenance plan (where applicable) of at least the water butt with overflow shall be submitted to, and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. It must be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged offsite and an overall reduction in peak flow rate and volume.</span></div><div><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space: pre-wrap; text-align: justify;"><br></span></div><div><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space: pre-wrap; text-align: justify;">Reason: </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space: pre-wrap;"> In the interest of sustainable drainage. </span></div>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-4c8022d0-7fff-d798-2879-f4b19c126779"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">A scheme for the provision and implementation of flood resilient and resistant construction details and measures for the site and in the basement against surface water (overland flow) flood risk shall be submitted to and agreed, in writing with the LPA in consultation with the LLFA prior to the construction of the measures. The scheme shall be carried out in its entirety before the basement is occupied and; constructed and completed in accordance with the approved plans in line with BS 8102:2022 Protection of below ground structures against water ingress - code of practice and current best practice where applicable.</span></span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-4c8022d0-7fff-d798-2879-f4b19c126779"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-8b27a217-7fff-78aa-9cdf-06bb74a3dc35"><span style="font-size: 14px; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">&nbsp;In the interest of flood risk mitigation. </span></span></span></span></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 15px;">A minimum of 2 bird boxes incorporated into the design of the development, with a variety of box types (including different sized entrance holes) to provide habitat for diverse bird species. The boxes should be installed at or close to the eaves level of the development hereby approved. The boxes should be between 3 and 5 metres from the ground, and there should be a clear flight path without any obstructions below and directly in front of the box. The boxes should be facing north, east or north east (direct sunlight should be avoided), and should not be placed immediately above doors or windows. <i>Boxes located in the same area should not be placed too close together.&nbsp;</i></p><p style="margin-left: 15px;"><div style="text-align: justify;"><b>Reason:</b></div><div style="text-align: justify;">To support bird and bat populations, including swifts, in Hackney and preserve endangered urban biodiversity, by providing nesting opportunities, in accordance with Hackney’s Local Plan LP33 policy LP47 which states that all development schemes involving buildings with an eaves height or roof commencement height of 5 metres and above are required to provide nesting boxes for swifts, sparrows, starlings, and/or bats as appropriate.</div></p><div style="text-align: justify; "><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"></div>
